name: How long does new construction plumbing installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does new construction plumbing installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of new construction plumbing installation varies greatly depending on the project's scale and complexity. For an average single-family home, the rough-in phase might take 1-3 weeks, while the finish plumbing phase could take an additional 3-7 days. Larger or more complex homes, or commercial projects, will naturally require more time. Coordination with other construction trades and timely inspections also impact the overall timeline. We provide a detailed schedule with each project proposal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size; rough-in typically takes 1-3 weeks, and finish plumbing adds 3-7 days for an average home.
